steps.what: Find current literature and professional developments relevant to nursing teaching

loop.purpose: Suggest relevant literature for a defined teaching topic
loop.input: Instructor's topic and current indexed literature
loop.output: Reading shortlist with resolvable references and relevance reasons
loop.check: Instructor verifies each source exists, reads original abstracts and checks relevance, date and evidence type
loop.stop: One shortlist; unresolved references are discarded and uncertain coverage returns to manual search
loop.why_not_simpler: Search filters narrow the field but relevance spans differently worded topics

steps.what: Read current literature, talk with colleagues and participate in professional conferences

tasks.design: Use native {OTHER} scholarly-search filters and alerts before an optional relevance loop. Keep original reading, colleague discussion and conference participation fully counted; a summary is not professional learning.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant developments are spread across a large literature.
tasks.enabler_now: Scholarly tools offer topic summaries and foundational-paper discovery.
tasks.still_hard: Determining whether a finding changes teaching or practice.
tasks.human_edge: Critically appraise evidence and discuss its implications.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less discovery effort, with learning time unchanged.

evidence.claim: Scopus AI provides topic summaries and foundational-paper discovery.
Only the discovery share is reduced; the nursing-instructor saving is an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is professional updating, excluding writing revised course content.
Instructor defines topics, date limits and relevance constraints within s1's12 retained hours; no pre-tagged complete evidence feed is assumed.
Missing references require manual catalogue search, and all substantive reading and discussion remain80 hours.
Native alerts and search configuration come first; additional shortlist review upkeep is counted below.
unknowns: Current discovery effort and catalogue access
research_questions: Does assisted discovery find relevant sources after reference and coverage checks are timed?

already_counted.description: Define search and verify proposed references

incremental.description: Tune topic alerts and review discovery omissions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R92 gross8 minus3 upkeep =5 net E1. High requires broad manual discovery; low covers already effective alerts or repeated irrelevant results.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Evaluate curricula, course content and instructional methods against teaching needs
Draft revisions to course content, materials and methods of instruction

loop.purpose: Draft teaching-content revisions from an instructor-approved brief
loop.input: Changed outcomes, approved sources, scope and teaching constraints
loop.output: Draft revisions linked to brief requirements and source passages
loop.check: Instructor checks clinical meaning, outcome coverage, learner level and consistency with approved sources
loop.stop: One revision; unsupported clinical statements or changed competency requirements return to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates organise content but cannot express topic-specific instructional changes

steps.what: Review the revised curriculum and agree the final teaching changes

tasks.design: Use native {DOCS} course templates with an optional bounded loop to express agreed revisions. Keep curriculum evaluation, clinical source checking and final instructor review; program approval follows its existing process.
tasks.previous_blocker: Approved teaching changes still require repeated content rewriting.
tasks.enabler_now: Constrained drafting can start from a verified revision brief.
tasks.still_hard: Teaching text must preserve clinical meaning and expected competence.
tasks.human_edge: Judge curriculum validity and teaching suitability.
tasks.altitude: Less first-draft rewriting, with curriculum decisions unchanged.

reach.learn: Outcome mapping and clinical education requirements

evidence.claim: Drafting from approved changes may reduce prose rewriting, but the digest supplies no measured nursing-curriculum result.

assumptions: Boundary is curriculum revision, excluding professional updating, live teaching and program-level approval.
Instructor produces changed outcomes, intended learner level, source passages and constraints in s1's full40 hours; no ready-made clinical curriculum mapping is assumed.
Missing evidence requires manual source work; draft correction remains21 hours and final review25 hours.
Test native templates first. No generated clinical rule or competency standard is accepted without original-source review.
unknowns: Revision scope and program approval process
research_questions: Do reviewed drafts preserve clinical meaning and outcome coverage after correction time is included?

already_counted.description: Evaluate needs and capture verified revisions

incremental.description: Maintain revision structure and review drafting errors

approvals.approved_version: Exact revision text, learning outcomes and approved source versions; edits require renewed instructor review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R86 gross14 minus4 upkeep =10 net E1. High assumes settled changes and repeated rewriting; low covers major redesign or extensive clinical correction.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Capture attendance, decided grades and required student-record corrections
Transfer student attendance records and grades into the required official register
Check required records, resolve mismatches and accept the register update

tasks.design: Test native {LMS} export or synchronisation into the {OTHER} student register to replace duplicate entry. Retain attendance capture, grade decisions and transfer reconciliation; no model evaluates student achievement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Learning-system grades may also require publication in a separate official register.
tasks.enabler_now: Structured records can be transferred through an approved field mapping.
tasks.still_hard: Wrong student, course, attempt or grade status can produce a plausible but incorrect record.
tasks.human_edge: Resolve exceptions and confirm what the official record should say.
tasks.altitude: Less duplicate entry where a separate register exists.

evidence.claim: Radboud requires grades in Brightspace also to be published in OSIRIS, establishing a named double-publication workflow rather than a universal nursing practice.
The proposed duplicate-entry reduction assumes an available approved interface and is not measured locally.

assumptions: Boundary is record maintenance after grading; clinical and academic grading decisions are excluded and retain their own time.

Instructor produces checked student id, course id, session or assessment id, attempt, attendance status or decided grade and correction version in s1's full40 hours. Missing identifiers require manual capture before transfer.
Student records administrator maintains existing register definitions; extra mapping maintenance is counted below. Final mismatch checking remains25 hours in s3.
Test native approved synchronisation before custom code. If only one register exists or transfer is already automatic, this design has no duplicate-entry benefit.
unknowns: Separate register requirement and approved interface
research_questions: Can a controlled export reconcile every student, course, attempt and correction without changing the underlying decision?

already_counted.description: Source record capture and missing identifiers

incremental.description: Review transfer exceptions and changed register rules

approvals.approved_version: Exact source record snapshot, destination register, student, course and attempt mapping; corrections require renewed acceptance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R65 gross35 minus4 upkeep =31 net E1. High needs duplicate manual entry and a reliable native interface; low covers one-register or already automated workflows.

tasks.short: Advise students on curricula and careers

steps.what: Advise students on academic and vocational curricula and career issues

tasks.design: Retain direct student advice supported by current curriculum information in {DOCS}. No automated career choice or student profiling is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Student goals and circumstances require dialogue.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing information supports the unchanged advice.
tasks.still_hard: Helping a student weigh realistic options without deciding for them.
tasks.human_edge: Listen, clarify and refer when specialist support is needed.

reach.learn: Referral routes and course progression rules

evidence.claim: Individual student guidance remains fully counted personal work.

assumptions: Boundary is the advising conversation, excluding separately counted official records.
Student supplies goals and questions during the retained step; curriculum owner maintains existing requirements. No structured student profile is assumed.
No new software configuration or incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Which student questions need specialist support beyond the instructor?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 upkeep0 net0; student advice remains direct discussion.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce literature discovery, repeated curriculum prose and duplicate record entry where those workloads exist; retain professional learning and student judgement.
reach: Coordinate with librarians and student records staff
role.ambitious_version: A nursing instructor with less repeated preparation and record entry, while preserving learning and student support time.
